deaca.title: deacá
deaca.description: End-to-end development and implementation of an interactive web platform centralizing local commerce, tourism and events in Olavarría. Modern interactive guide to discover local products and services as well as tourist information, events and places to visit in the city. Stack: React, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Docker. Integrations: MercadoPago (Checkout/Payments), Google Maps Platform (Maps, Places, Geocoding), Google OAuth. DevTools & AI Workflow: OpenCode with dedicated database persistence for context/conversations, autonomous agents and custom skills. Responsibilities & achievements: Full-Stack & UX/UI — designed and implemented the React interface and NestJS service architecture with a smooth, intuitive navigation flow; API & Payments Integration — advanced geolocation and seamless MercadoPago integration for in-platform transactions; AI-optimized workflows — configured advanced OpenCode pipelines with dedicated DB to accelerate the dev cycle via agents and automation; Infrastructure & Quality — Dockerized deployments to homogenize environments and ensure stability through automated testing and staging.

forgebytes.title: ForgeBytes Lab
forgebytes.description: Freelance Full Stack Developer (Founder). I design, develop, and deploy end-to-end web and mobile applications using React, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Docker. I manage self-hosted infrastructure on VPS, configuring Linux, SSH, Nginx, and Docker-based CI/CD pipelines. I implement cybersecurity best practices and have adopted Coolify for streamlined operations. I also implement local AI models to provide modern chatbot solutions for client applications.

biggertech.title: Bigger
biggertech.description: Developed and maintained production systems using React, NestJS, MySQL, and TypeScript. Built cross-platform mobile applications with React Native + Expo for Android and iOS, acting as the sole owner of the iOS build and release process. Integrated third-party services such as Stripe, Cybrid, AWS Cognito, AWS S3, and Auth0. Worked with hexagonal architecture and contributed to smart contract development using Rust and Soroban for the Stellar Network.

mayland.title: Mayland Labs
mayland.description: Part-time Full Stack Developer. Developed advanced frontend and backend features using React, NestJS, and PostgreSQL. Implemented complex business logic across modular backend services and interactive frontend components. Integrated Google Maps, OAuth, Google Analytics, and MercadoPago payment solutions.
